title: Revenue movement analysis
notes: Synthetic analysis case grounded in AG2's implemented revenue template and derived-fact substrate; the roadmap's Stripe Snapshot product packaging is a planned extension.
reviewQuestions: Can an executive distinguish the current revenue figure from the movements that explain it?
Are anomalies, period, and source freshness clear enough to support a follow-up decision?
outcomes: A user can explain the period-over-period movement without reconstructing it from raw rows.
A user can identify which anomalies deserve investigation and export a concise summary.
